definitions.definition: Exposure-weighted one-dimensional Wasserstein distance between reference and generated import-energy distributions within matched cohort and hour strata.
definitions.scope_contract: matched cohort_id and UTC hour strata

definitions.definition: Maximum exposure-weighted two-sample empirical-CDF distance within matched cohort and hour strata, aggregated by reference exposure.
definitions.scope_contract: matched cohort_id and UTC hour strata

definitions.definition: Exposure-weighted mean absolute error between reference and generated import-energy autocorrelation at the declared positive lags.
definitions.scope_contract: matched cohort series and declared lags

definitions.definition: Distance between reference and generated peak-time distributions under a registered physical reference.
Absolute error between reference and generated average-to-peak load factors under a registered physical reference.
Maximum positive interval residual where represented meter export exceeds generated DER production under the controlled procedural energy convention.
definitions.scope_contract: one scenario and replicate across all represented DER intervals

definitions.definition: Fraction of required network-state time points represented by a declared solver or analytic backend without a convergence-failure flag.
definitions.scope_contract: all required network state rows in the replicate

definitions.definition: Fraction of network-state rows carrying an under-voltage or over-voltage violation flag.
definitions.scope_contract: network state rows with modeled voltage

definitions.definition: Fraction of network-state rows carrying an overload violation flag.
definitions.scope_contract: network state rows with modeled loading

definitions.definition: Observed arrival count divided by integrated expected count for the declared model and scenario.
Arrival-bin count variance divided by mean, interpreted under the declared arrival model class.
definitions.scope_contract: scenario, replicate and arrival model bins

definitions.definition: Kolmogorov-Smirnov statistic for time-rescaled arrival residuals under the declared intensity model.
Poisson or conditioned-multinomial deviance against integrated bin intensities.
definitions.scope_contract: scenario, replicate and arrival model bins

definitions.definition: Mean absolute distance of transformed interarrival spacings from the unit-exponential target under the declared exact arrival model.
Error between configured and realized Hawkes cross-family branching statistics.
Maximum error between realized and target MMPP regime occupancy.
Count of unresolved foreign-key references found by the complete S13 foreign-key validator.
definitions.scope_contract: all authoritative tables available to S13

definitions.definition: Distance between generated and registered reference role/relationship degree distributions.
definitions.scope_contract: matched actor classes and relationship types

definitions.definition: Distance between generated and registered reference object/replica custody-component size distributions.
Distance between generated and registered reference replica counts per object by type and region.
Represented-event-weighted fraction of policy decisions classified cross-region from actual actor, database, replica, and jurisdiction facts.
definitions.scope_contract: policy decisions joined to governance event exposure

definitions.definition: Fraction of non-anomalous generated transitions accepted by their versioned workflow automata.
Represented-event-weighted fraction of workflows ending in an allowed terminal state, emitted overall and by workflow family.
definitions.scope_contract: workflow instances overall and by family

definitions.definition: Distance between generated and registered reference workflow-duration distributions by family.
Fraction of non-root governance events missing a required incoming causal dependency.
Count of cycles among edge types declared acyclic by the causal graph contract.
Count of governance events whose stored causal depth differs from recomputation over authoritative event edges.
Closure-added sample rows divided by directly selected primary rows for each dependency-closed probability design.
Exact expected-action and violation agreement on the independently authored policy golden suite.
Fraction of policy decisions carrying a non-empty applicable rule and explanation trace.
Agreement with independently authored expected outcomes for conflict cases in the pinned golden policy suite.
Fraction of accepted counterfactual anomalies for which the selected target invariant fails.
Fraction of accepted counterfactual anomalies violating at least one protected non-target invariant.
Mean declared minimal edit cost of accepted counterfactual pairs under the pinned edit grammar and search bounds.
Weighted empirical Bayes label accuracy obtainable from protected non-target invariant-status signatures within accepted counterfactual pairs.
definitions.scope_contract: valid and invalid members of accepted counterfactual pairs

definitions.definition: Fraction of required evidence coverage members reached by independently valid and timely receipts.
F1 score from precision and recall of declared obligation sufficiency against independently recomputed sufficiency truth.
definitions.denominator_contract: obligation-level declared and independent sufficiency labels

definitions.definition: Fraction of evidence receipts independently verified as valid under their configured synthetic evidence profile.
Fraction of emitted receipts independently verified as issued no later than their obligation deadline.
Fraction of deliberately contradictory receipt fixtures detected independently as contradiction-bearing.
Canonical receipt, detached fixture, key, and anchor bytes processed per evidence obligation; CPU and memory cost are not inferred from this deterministic byte census.
Represented-event-weighted fraction of world events visible across non-omniscient observer profiles.
definitions.scope_contract: configured non-full observer profiles and world-event exposure
definitions.denominator_contract: world-event exposure multiplied by observer profile count

definitions.definition: Represented-destination-event-weighted fraction of required authoritative causal edges whose endpoints are visible to non-full observers.
definitions.scope_contract: configured non-full observer profiles and required causal edges
definitions.denominator_contract: required edge exposure across observer profiles

definitions.definition: Count of forbidden truth fields, values, identifiers, pair keys, or protected inclusion data found in releasable observer views.
definitions.scope_contract: all releasable observer view scalar fields

definitions.definition: Fraction of required evidence recoverable across non-full observer profiles.
Recoverability increase for declared colluding observer compositions over their strongest member.
Kish effective sample size computed as squared weight sum divided by sum of squared weights within each probability design.
Absolute relative difference between the Horvitz-Thompson estimate of primary-unit population size and the declared primary-unit population size.
Selected primary-unit count divided by Kish effective sample size for each probability design.
Repeated-design relative bias of an eligible estimator against a known synthetic population total.
definitions.scope_contract: one eligible design and known-total analysis domain

definitions.definition: Repeated-design coverage of the declared nominal confidence interval against a known synthetic total.
definitions.scope_contract: one eligible design and known-total analysis domain

definitions.definition: Repeated-design relative root-mean-square error against a known synthetic total.
definitions.scope_contract: one eligible design and known-total analysis domain

definitions.definition: Fraction of visible workflow events belonging to a workflow event-type signature observed exactly once within each releasable observer profile.
Fraction of released comparable rows whose canonical comparison projection exactly matches a registered source or calibration record.
definitions.scope_contract: declared comparable released and source projections

definitions.definition: Nearest-neighbor distance ratio between released records and a registered source-population comparison set.
definitions.scope_contract: registered comparable source and released feature projections

definitions.definition: AUC of a predeclared membership-inference attack against a registered source-population comparison set.
Predictive gain over a predeclared baseline for protected attributes in a registered source-population comparison set.
Indicator that all authoritative table digests equal a separately executed clean-rerun reference under the declared worker-count comparison.
definitions.scope_contract: all authoritative pre-metric tables in the clean-rerun comparison

definitions.definition: Fraction of supplied stored artifacts represented exactly once by a schema-valid manifest row with matching digest, byte count, record count, and schema ID.
Measured canonical rows generated divided by externally observed elapsed wall-clock seconds under a pinned measurement profile.
Externally measured peak resident memory under the declared process or aggregate measurement method.
Measured compressed stored bytes divided by canonical governance-event rows for the declared artifact scope.
definitions.scope_contract: declared stored artifact and governance-event scope

definitions.definition: Separately measured serial elapsed time divided by parallel elapsed time and effective worker count; worker-count one is the declared serial identity case.
definitions.scope_contract: same resolved config and semantic digest under declared serial and parallel worker counts
definitions.denominator_contract: parallel elapsed seconds times effective workers

definitions.definition: Mean measured fill ratio against the pinned uncompressed Parquet row-group byte target across stage-owned authoritative tables.
definitions.denominator_contract: measured row groups with a pinned byte target

definitions.definition: Measured compressed Parquet bytes divided by generated rows for each profiled semantic stage and its declared table ownership.
definitions.scope_contract: one profiled semantic stage in the measurement pass
